entries.en: Use the centre lead.
entries.sourceEnglish: Use the centre lead.

entries.en: Do not go to the liferaft stations before ordered.
entries.zh: 未接到命令，不要前往救生筏集合站。
entries.sourceEnglish: Do not go to the liferaft stations before ordered.

entries.en: Yes, the anchor is holding.
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, the anchor is holding.

entries.en: Brief all crew members on the symptoms caused by dangerous substances.
entries.zh: 向全体船员说明危险物质引起的症状。
entries.sourceEnglish: Brief all crew members on the symptoms caused by dangerous substances.

entries.en: Slack away the breast line.
entries.sourceEnglish: Slack away the breast line.

entries.en: Instruct the pumpman and report.
entries.zh: 向泵工交代任务并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Instruct the pumpman and report.

entries.en: Hold on the forward spring.
entries.sourceEnglish: Hold on the forward spring.

entries.en: Rain is in the area.
entries.sourceEnglish: Rain is in the area.

entries.en: Yes, the humidity recorders in the holds are operational.
entries.zh: 是的，货舱内各湿度记录仪正常工作。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, the humidity recorders in the holds are operational.

entries.en: No, the holds are not free of smell.
entries.sourceEnglish: No, the holds are not free of smell.

entries.en: Call the watch engineer.
entries.sourceEnglish: Call the watch engineer.

entries.en: Stand by bridge team.
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by bridge team.

entries.en: Stern thruster full to port.
entries.sourceEnglish: Stern thruster full to port.

entries.en: Yes, the cargo list is available and complete.
entries.zh: 是的，货物清单齐全，可以提供。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, the cargo list is available and complete.

entries.en: Close all openings in all rooms and report.
entries.zh: 关闭所有房间的全部开口并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Close all openings in all rooms and report.

entries.en: Sound ''man overboard'' alarm.
entries.sourceEnglish: Sound ''man overboard'' alarm.

entries.en: Is the radar operational?
entries.sourceEnglish: Is the radar operational?

entries.en: I cannot control flooding.
entries.sourceEnglish: I cannot control flooding.

entries.en: Close all outlets and report.
entries.zh: 关闭所有排出口并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Close all outlets and report.

entries.en: Change the radar to relative head-up.
entries.zh: 将雷达改为相对运动、首向上显示模式。
entries.sourceEnglish: Change the radar to relative head-up.

entries.en: Check the smoke alarm and report.
entries.zh: 检查烟雾报警器并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the smoke alarm and report.

entries.en: Refuse damaged packings with dangerous goods.
entries.zh: 拒收包装损坏的危险货物。
entries.sourceEnglish: Refuse damaged packings with dangerous goods.

entries.en: What is the maximum reach of the crane?
entries.zh: 起重机最大工作幅度是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the maximum reach of the crane?

entries.en: No, fire not extinguished yet.
entries.sourceEnglish: No, fire not extinguished yet.

entries.en: Dry-docking is necessary.
entries.sourceEnglish: Dry - docking is necessary.

entries.en: Replace the missing hoses.
entries.sourceEnglish: Replace the missing hoses.

entries.en: A vessel is passing on port side.
entries.sourceEnglish: A vessel is passing on port side.

entries.en: Do you have any deficiencies?
entries.sourceEnglish: Do you have any deficiencies?

entries.en: Search for missing crew member and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Search for missing crew member and report.

entries.en: Yes, I am ready for the helicopter.
entries.zh: 是的，我船已做好接应直升机的准备。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, I am ready for the helicopter.

entries.en: I have damage above waterline.
entries.zh: 我船水线以上部位受损。
entries.sourceEnglish: I have damage above waterline.

entries.en: Keep within the safe working load of derricks.
entries.zh: 起货吊杆作业应保持在安全工作负荷以内。
entries.sourceEnglish: Keep within the safe working load of derricks.

entries.en: What is the result of search?
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the result of search?

entries.en: Stand by for making fast the tugs.
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by for making fast the tugs.

entries.en: The contents of drums are unknown.
entries.sourceEnglish: The contents of drums are unknown.

entries.en: What is the pressure in the inerted tanks?
entries.zh: 已惰化液舱内的压力是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the pressure in the inerted tanks?

entries.en: Who needs medical first aid?
entries.sourceEnglish: Who needs medical first aid?

entries.en: From what direction are you approaching?
entries.zh: 你船正从哪个方向驶近？
entries.sourceEnglish: From what direction are you approaching?

entries.en: We use the towing lines of the tugs.
entries.sourceEnglish: We use the towing lines of the tugs.

entries.en: Check the power supply and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the power supply and report.

entries.en: The watertight door control is operational.
entries.zh: 水密门控制装置正常工作。
entries.sourceEnglish: The watertight door control is operational.

entries.en: There was a breakdown of the main engine.
entries.sourceEnglish: There was a breakdown of the main engine.

entries.en: Yes, the cargo hoses are connected.
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, the cargo hoses are connected.

entries.en: Walk back port one shackle.
entries.sourceEnglish: Walk back port one shackle.

entries.en: Check the proper use of handling gear.
entries.zh: 检查装卸属具是否正确使用。
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the proper use of handling gear.

entries.en: When your name is called out, please answer loudly ''Here''.
entries.zh: 点到姓名时，请大声回答“到”。
entries.sourceEnglish: When your name is called out, please answer loudly ''Here''.

entries.en: Send the stern line ashore.
entries.sourceEnglish: Send the stern line ashore.

entries.en: Yes, I am on even keel.
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, I am on even keel.

entries.en: Secure the heavy lifts immediately.
entries.sourceEnglish: Secure the heavy lifts immediately.

entries.en: Yes, the inert gas system is operational.
entries.zh: 是的，惰性气体系统正常工作。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, the inert gas system is operational.

entries.en: No, dockside cranes are not available.
entries.sourceEnglish: No, dockside cranes are not available.

entries.en: How many lifeboats with how many persons will you launch?
entries.zh: 你船将放下几艘救生艇，每艘载多少人？
entries.sourceEnglish: How many lifeboats with how many persons will you launch?

entries.en: Is the certificate of survey available and complete?
entries.zh: 检验证书是否齐全并可提供？
entries.sourceEnglish: Is the certificate of survey available and complete?

entries.en: The pilot boat is coming to you.
entries.sourceEnglish: The pilot boat is coming to you.

entries.en: I cannot send divers.
entries.sourceEnglish: I cannot send divers.

entries.en: No, I cannot stop spillage.
entries.sourceEnglish: No, I cannot stop spillage.

entries.en: Give assistance when entering lifeboats.
entries.zh: 在人员进入救生艇时给予协助。
entries.sourceEnglish: Give assistance when entering lifeboats.

entries.en: Brief all crew members on the storm.
entries.zh: 向全体船员说明风暴情况。
entries.sourceEnglish: Brief all crew members on the storm.

entries.en: Yes, dangerous goods are on fire.
entries.zh: 是的，危险货物正在燃烧。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, dangerous goods are on fire.

entries.en: What is the manoeuvring speed at half ahead?
entries.zh: 半速前进时的操纵航速是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the manoeuvring speed at half ahead?

entries.en: Do you have a controllable or fixed pitch propeller?
entries.zh: 你船使用可调螺距螺旋桨还是固定螺距螺旋桨？
entries.sourceEnglish: Do you have a controllable or fixed pitch propeller?

entries.en: Do not enter the unmanned engine room without permission.
entries.zh: 未经许可，不得进入无人值守机舱。
entries.sourceEnglish: Do not enter the unmanned engine room without permission.

entries.en: The flooding is under control.
entries.sourceEnglish: The flooding is under control.

entries.en: Keep sharp lookout for lifeboats.
entries.sourceEnglish: Keep sharp lookout for lifeboats.

entries.en: Stop in present position and wait for the pilot.
entries.zh: 在当前位置停船，等候引航员。
entries.sourceEnglish: Stop in present position and wait for the pilot.

entries.en: What is the name of your vessel and call sign?
entries.zh: 你船的船名和呼号是什么？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the name of your vessel and call sign?

entries.en: Observe the IMDG-Code when stowing.
entries.zh: 积载时遵守《国际海运危险货物规则》。
entries.sourceEnglish: Observe the IMDG-Code when stowing.

entries.en: You are running into danger - risk of collision.
entries.zh: 你船正驶入险境，有碰撞危险。
entries.sourceEnglish: You are running into danger - risk of collision.

entries.en: Let go all aft.
entries.sourceEnglish: Let go all aft.

entries.en: Stand by lines and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by lines and report.

entries.en: We will alter course to give way.
entries.sourceEnglish: We will alter course to give way.

entries.en: Is the cargo list available and complete?
entries.zh: 货物清单是否齐全并可提供？
entries.sourceEnglish: Is the cargo list available and complete?

entries.en: Do not touch the spillage.
entries.sourceEnglish: Do not touch the spillage.

entries.en: Are floating cranes available?
entries.zh: 是否有可用的浮式起重机？
entries.sourceEnglish: Are floating cranes available?

entries.en: Stand by emergency foam monitor and report.
entries.zh: 备好应急泡沫炮并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by emergency foam monitor and report.

entries.en: Watertight door not operational.
entries.sourceEnglish: Watertight door not operational.

entries.en: Stand by boat crews and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by boat crews and report.

entries.en: Fifteen minutes notice is required.
entries.sourceEnglish: Fifteen minutes notice is required.

entries.en: The fire alarm is cancelled.
entries.sourceEnglish: The fire alarm is cancelled.

entries.en: You are approaching a prohibited fishing area.
entries.sourceEnglish: You are approaching a prohibited fishing area.

entries.en: The pilot ladder has loose steps.
entries.sourceEnglish: The pilot ladder has loose steps.

entries.en: I will complete the manoeuvre.
entries.sourceEnglish: I will complete the manoeuvre.

entries.en: Close and secure the stern door and report.
entries.zh: 关闭并固定尾门，然后报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Close and secure the stern door and report.

entries.en: Switch on the hold ventilation to supply air.
entries.zh: 启动货舱通风设备进行送风。
entries.sourceEnglish: Switch on the hold ventilation to supply air.

entries.en: You must proceed by the fairway.
entries.sourceEnglish: You must proceed by the fairway.

entries.en: The danger area is secured.
entries.sourceEnglish: The danger area is secured.

entries.en: Missing crew member not recovered yet - search is continuing.
entries.zh: 尚未找到失踪船员，搜寻仍在继续。
entries.sourceEnglish: Missing crew member not recovered yet - search is continuing.

entries.en: Do not use elevators.
entries.sourceEnglish: Do not use elevators.

entries.en: Have a heaving line ready at the pilot ladder.
entries.sourceEnglish: Have a heaving line ready at the pilot ladder.

entries.en: What was the number of lifeboats launched?
entries.sourceEnglish: What was the number of lifeboats launched?

entries.en: I am in danger of capsizing, list increasing.
entries.zh: 我船有倾覆危险，横倾正在加剧。
entries.sourceEnglish: I am in danger of capsizing, list increasing.

entries.en: Let go sea anchor and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Let go sea anchor and report.

entries.en: Is the engine a diesel or a turbine?
entries.zh: 主机是柴油机还是汽轮机？
entries.sourceEnglish: Is the engine a diesel or a turbine?

entries.en: How long does it take to change the engines from ahead to astern?
entries.zh: 主机由前进转换到后退需要多长时间？
entries.sourceEnglish: How long does it take to change the engines from ahead to astern?

entries.en: Switch on the hold ventilation to exhaust air.
entries.zh: 启动货舱通风设备进行排风。
entries.sourceEnglish: Switch on the hold ventilation to exhaust air.

entries.en: Inform the engine room.
entries.sourceEnglish: Inform the engine room.

entries.en: What kind of assistance is required?
entries.sourceEnglish: What kind of assistance is required?

entries.en: Yes, the radar is operational.
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, the radar is operational.

entries.en: Switch on the hold lights.
entries.sourceEnglish: Switch on the hold lights.

entries.en: These goods are liable to spontaneous heating and combustion.
entries.zh: 这些货物容易自热、自燃。
entries.sourceEnglish: These goods are liable to spontaneous heating and combustion.

entries.en: Port engines full astern.
entries.sourceEnglish: Port engines full astern.

entries.en: What is the grain capacity of vessel?
entries.zh: 船舶的散装舱容是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the grain capacity of vessel?

entries.en: Are your tanks inerted?
entries.zh: 你船各液舱是否已惰化？
entries.sourceEnglish: Are your tanks inerted?

entries.en: Heave up both cables.
entries.sourceEnglish: Heave up both cables.

entries.en: Heave on the stern line.
entries.sourceEnglish: Heave on the stern line.

entries.en: Check the smoke alarms and report.
entries.zh: 检查各烟雾报警器并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the smoke alarms and report.

entries.en: Finished with engines - no more manoeuvring.
entries.sourceEnglish: Finished with engines - no more manoeuvring.

entries.en: Port engines dead slow astern.
entries.sourceEnglish: Port engines dead slow astern.

entries.en: The echo sounder recordings are unreliable.
entries.sourceEnglish: The echo sounder recordings are unreliable.

entries.en: Bilge pumps switched on.
entries.sourceEnglish: Bilge pumps switched on.

entries.en: Use the starboard quarter lead.
entries.zh: 使用右舷尾部导缆装置。
entries.sourceEnglish: Use the starboard quarter lead.

entries.en: Take immediate action to recover injured persons.
entries.zh: 立即采取行动救起受伤人员。
entries.sourceEnglish: Take immediate action to recover injured persons.

entries.en: Hold on the port cable.
entries.sourceEnglish: Hold on the port cable.

entries.en: What is the latest ice information?
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the latest ice information?

entries.en: I am not under command.
entries.sourceEnglish: I am not under command.

entries.en: What is the maximum discharging rate?
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the maximum discharging rate?

entries.en: Wind is backing and decreasing.
entries.zh: 风向正逆时针转变，风力正在减弱。
entries.sourceEnglish: Wind is backing and decreasing.

entries.en: Do you require a pilot?
entries.sourceEnglish: Do you require a pilot?

entries.en: Missing crew member not recovered.
entries.sourceEnglish: Missing crew member not recovered.

entries.en: No, bilge pumps not operational yet.
entries.zh: 不，舱底泵尚不能正常工作。
entries.sourceEnglish: No, bilge pumps not operational yet.

entries.en: Yes, fenders are on the berth.
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, fenders are on the berth.

entries.en: Visibility is reduced by dust.
entries.sourceEnglish: Visibility is reduced by dust.

entries.en: Is your radar in operation?
entries.zh: 你船的雷达是否正常工作？
entries.sourceEnglish: Is your radar in operation?

entries.en: Report the result of the diving survey.
entries.sourceEnglish: Report the result of the diving survey.

entries.en: What is your MMSI number?
entries.zh: 你船的海上移动业务识别码是什么？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is your MMSI number?

entries.en: No, my tanks are not inerted yet.
entries.zh: 不，我船各液舱尚未惰化。
entries.sourceEnglish: No, my tanks are not inerted yet.

entries.en: What is the manoeuvring speed at full ahead?
entries.zh: 全速前进时的操纵航速是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the manoeuvring speed at full ahead?

entries.en: Slack out the cables.
entries.sourceEnglish: Slack out the cables.

entries.en: Bonding wire is fitted.
entries.sourceEnglish: Bonding wire is fitted.

entries.en: Hatch covers closed and secured.
entries.sourceEnglish: Hatch covers closed and secured.

entries.en: Shoreside assistance is required.
entries.sourceEnglish: Shoreside assistance is required.

entries.en: How much weight is on the cable?
entries.sourceEnglish: How much weight is on the cable?

entries.en: The barometer is rising rapidly.
entries.sourceEnglish: The barometer is rising rapidly.

entries.en: Are there dangers to navigation?
entries.sourceEnglish: Are there dangers to navigation?

entries.en: There are enough life-saving appliances for everyone on board.
entries.zh: 船上的救生设备足供全体人员使用。
entries.sourceEnglish: There are enough life-saving appliances for everyone on board.

entries.en: What is your air draft?
entries.zh: 你船水面以上最大高度是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is your air draft?

entries.en: Provide first aid in the vessel's hospital.
entries.zh: 在船上医务室实施急救。
entries.sourceEnglish: Provide first aid in the vessel's hospital.

entries.en: What is your freeboard?
entries.zh: 你船的干舷高度是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is your freeboard?

entries.en: Yes, you must take a pilot - pilotage is compulsory.
entries.zh: 是的，你船必须使用引航员，此处实行强制引航。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, you must take a pilot - pilotage is compulsory.

entries.en: Survivor is in bad condition.
entries.sourceEnglish: Survivor is in bad condition.

entries.en: All liferafts are in position and operational.
entries.zh: 所有救生筏均已就位并可用。
entries.sourceEnglish: All liferafts are in position and operational.

entries.en: Muster damage control team and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Muster damage control team and report.

entries.en: Follow closely the demonstration given by the officer.
entries.zh: 仔细观看驾驶员的示范。
entries.sourceEnglish: Follow closely the demonstration given by the officer.

entries.en: Provisions and drinking water will be distributed by an officer only.
entries.zh: 只有驾驶员负责分发食品和饮用水。
entries.sourceEnglish: Provisions and drinking water will be distributed by an officer only.

entries.en: Close the discharges and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Close the discharges and report.

entries.en: I require ice breaker escort.
entries.sourceEnglish: I require ice breaker escort.

entries.en: No weight is on the cable.
entries.sourceEnglish: No weight is on the cable.

entries.en: All escape routes are clear.
entries.sourceEnglish: All escape routes are clear.

entries.en: Report number of all passengers at assembly stations.
entries.zh: 报告集合站的旅客总人数。
entries.sourceEnglish: Report number of all passengers at assembly stations.

entries.en: Stand by lookout in the port wing.
entries.zh: 安排瞭望人员到左舷驾驶台翼桥待命。
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by lookout in the port wing.

entries.en: Hold on the breast line.
entries.sourceEnglish: Hold on the breast line.

entries.en: Can you stop spillage?
entries.sourceEnglish: Can you stop spillage?

entries.en: The fire is not under control yet.
entries.sourceEnglish: The fire is not under control yet.

entries.en: Are the holds dry?
entries.sourceEnglish: Are the holds dry?

entries.en: Replace the missing lifebuoys.
entries.sourceEnglish: Replace the missing lifebuoys.

entries.en: What wind is expected in my position?
entries.zh: 预计我船所在位置的风况如何？
entries.sourceEnglish: What wind is expected in my position?

entries.en: The engine is a turbine.
entries.sourceEnglish: The engine is a turbine.

entries.en: Fire is in engine-room.
entries.sourceEnglish: Fire is in engine-room.

entries.en: Fishing gear has fouled my propellers.
entries.zh: 渔具缠住了我船螺旋桨。
entries.sourceEnglish: Fishing gear has fouled my propellers.

entries.en: Do not enter lower deck.
entries.sourceEnglish: Do not enter lower deck.

entries.en: Stand by lookout on the bridge.
entries.zh: 安排瞭望人员到驾驶台待命。
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by lookout on the bridge.

entries.en: What was the number of persons in water?
entries.sourceEnglish: What was the number of persons in water?

entries.en: Stand by fire fighting team and report.
entries.zh: 消防队做好准备并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Stand by fire fighting team and report.

entries.en: The hatch covers are in order.
entries.sourceEnglish: The hatch covers are in order.

entries.en: What is the hold capacity of vessel?
entries.zh: 船舶的货舱容量是多少？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the hold capacity of vessel?

entries.en: Yes, the pilot boat is on station.
entries.zh: 是的，引航艇已在指定位置待命。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, the pilot boat is on station.

entries.en: Start the engine and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Start the engine and report.

entries.en: No, the holds are not dry.
entries.sourceEnglish: No, the holds are not dry.

entries.en: Check the skylights and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the skylights and report.

entries.en: Check the fuel of the lifeboat engines and report.
entries.zh: 检查救生艇发动机燃油并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the fuel of the lifeboat engines and report.

entries.en: What part is aground?
entries.sourceEnglish: What part is aground?

entries.en: I am ready to get underway.
entries.sourceEnglish: I am ready to get underway.

entries.en: I have problems with steering gear.
entries.zh: 我船操舵装置存在问题。
entries.sourceEnglish: I have problems with steering gear.

entries.en: What is local time?
entries.sourceEnglish: What is local time?

entries.en: The radar is true-motion north-up.
entries.zh: 雷达处于真运动、北向上显示模式。
entries.sourceEnglish: The radar is true-motion north-up.

entries.en: Clear the entrance of the lifeboat.
entries.sourceEnglish: Clear the entrance of the lifeboat.

entries.en: Is the anchor holding?
entries.sourceEnglish: Is the anchor holding?

entries.en: Check the correct fixing of the rope clips.
entries.zh: 检查钢丝绳夹是否正确固定。
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the correct fixing of the rope clips.

entries.en: I am flooding in the holds.
entries.sourceEnglish: I am flooding in the holds.

entries.en: Check the pumps and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the pumps and report.

entries.en: I have no damage.
entries.sourceEnglish: I have no damage.

entries.en: I require fire fighting assistance.
entries.sourceEnglish: I require fire fighting assistance.

entries.en: Let go the towing line.
entries.sourceEnglish: Let go the towing line.

entries.en: Order a surveyor to check the cargo securings.
entries.zh: 安排检验人员检查货物系固情况。
entries.sourceEnglish: Order a surveyor to check the cargo securings.

entries.en: Yes, I require medical assistance.
entries.zh: 是的，我船需要医疗援助。
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, I require medical assistance.

entries.en: Check the fire alarms and report.
entries.zh: 检查各火灾报警器并报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the fire alarms and report.

entries.en: The ventilation system is not operational.
entries.zh: 通风系统无法正常工作。
entries.sourceEnglish: The ventilation system is not operational.

entries.en: Check the escape routes and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Check the escape routes and report.

entries.en: Inform the vessels in vicinity on radio.
entries.zh: 通过无线电通知附近船舶。
entries.sourceEnglish: Inform the vessels in vicinity on radio.

entries.en: I am manoeuvring with difficulty.
entries.sourceEnglish: I am manoeuvring with difficulty.

entries.en: Lower and secure the cranes and report.
entries.zh: 放低并固定各起重机，然后报告。
entries.sourceEnglish: Lower and secure the cranes and report.

entries.en: Are dangerous goods on fire?
entries.zh: 危险货物是否正在燃烧？
entries.sourceEnglish: Are dangerous goods on fire?

entries.en: Replace the cut hoses.
entries.sourceEnglish: Replace the cut hoses.

entries.en: Shut down main engines and report.
entries.sourceEnglish: Shut down main engines and report.

entries.en: The pilot ladder is rigged on port side.
entries.sourceEnglish: The pilot ladder is rigged on port side.

entries.en: When was the last man overboard drill?
entries.zh: 上一次人员落水演习是什么时候？
entries.sourceEnglish: When was the last man overboard drill?

entries.en: Let go both anchors.
entries.sourceEnglish: Let go both anchors.

entries.en: Quantity received - stop pumping.
entries.sourceEnglish: Quantity received - stop pumping.

entries.en: Inform the coast radio station about the cancellation of search and rescue.
entries.zh: 通知岸台，搜救行动已取消。
entries.sourceEnglish: Inform the coast radio station about the cancellation of search and rescue.

entries.en: What is the weather situation in your position?
entries.zh: 你船所在位置的天气情况如何？
entries.sourceEnglish: What is the weather situation in your position?

entries.en: What is your cargo?
entries.sourceEnglish: What is your cargo?

entries.en: My cargo is coal.
entries.sourceEnglish: My cargo is coal.

entries.en: Stand by rescue net and report.

entries.en: The ship's damage control team is fighting the flooding.
entries.zh: 本船损管队正在控制进水。
entries.sourceEnglish: The ship's damage control team is fighting the flooding.

entries.en: You have the watch now.
entries.sourceEnglish: You have the watch now.

entries.en: We have radio contact with rescue craft.
entries.zh: 我船已与救助艇建立无线电联系。
entries.sourceEnglish: We have radio contact with rescue craft.

entries.en: The course board is written up.
entries.sourceEnglish: The course board is written up.

entries.en: We will send a MAYDAY.
entries.sourceEnglish: We will send a MAYDAY.

entries.en: The vessel has given way.
entries.sourceEnglish: The vessel has given way.

entries.en: Change the paper of the echo sounder.
entries.sourceEnglish: Change the paper of the echo sounder.

entries.en: Have a hook ready.
entries.sourceEnglish: Have a hook ready.

entries.en: Barometer is rising rapidly.
entries.sourceEnglish: Barometer is rising rapidly.

entries.en: Yes, I understand the standing orders.
entries.sourceEnglish: Yes, I understand the standing orders.

entries.en: All passengers with their lifejackets and blankets are requested to go to their assembly stations immediately.
entries.zh: 请所有旅客携带救生衣和毯子，立即前往各自集合站。
entries.sourceEnglish: All passengers with their lifejackets and blankets are requested to go to their assembly stations immediately.

entries.en: Pump out the water.
entries.sourceEnglish: Pump out the water.

entries.en: We will join the other liferafts.
entries.zh: 我筏将与其他救生筏会合。
entries.sourceEnglish: We will join the other liferafts.

entries.en: Automatic fog signal is switched on.
entries.sourceEnglish: Automatic fog signal is switched on.

entries.en: Strictly obey all instructions given by the lifeboatman.
entries.zh: 严格服从救生艇员的所有指令。
entries.sourceEnglish: Strictly obey all instructions given by the lifeboatman.

entries.en: Visibility is reduced by rain.
entries.sourceEnglish: Visibility is reduced by rain.

entries.en: Visibility is reduced by fog.
entries.sourceEnglish: Visibility is reduced by fog.

entries.en: Assist those who need help.
entries.sourceEnglish: Assist those who need help.

entries.en: The sea state is expected to change.
entries.sourceEnglish: The sea state is expected to change.

entries.en: Never smoke in bed.
entries.sourceEnglish: Never smoke in bed.

entries.en: Always act immediately if you detect fire or smell fumes or smoke.
entries.zh: 发现火情或闻到烟气时，立即采取行动。
entries.sourceEnglish: Always act immediately if you detect fire or smell fumes or smoke.

entries.en: Enter the lifeboat only when ordered by an officer.
entries.zh: 只有接到驾驶员命令后才能进入救生艇。
entries.sourceEnglish: Enter the lifeboat only when ordered by an officer.

entries.en: Do not push each other when entering the lifeboat.
entries.zh: 进入救生艇时不要互相推挤。
entries.sourceEnglish: Do not push each other when entering the lifeboat.

entries.en: Please follow the instructions given by the officers and crew.
entries.zh: 请遵从驾驶员和船员的指示。
entries.sourceEnglish: Please follow the instructions given by the officers and crew.

entries.en: At your assembly station one of the officers will perform a roll call.
entries.zh: 一名驾驶员将在集合站点名。
entries.sourceEnglish: At your assembly station one of the officers will perform a roll call.

entries.en: We will use smoke buoys to attract attention.
entries.zh: 我方将使用烟雾浮标引起注意。
entries.sourceEnglish: We will use smoke buoys to attract attention.

entries.en: Clear the entrance of the liferaft immediately after entering.
entries.zh: 进入救生筏后立即让开入口。
entries.sourceEnglish: Clear the entrance of the liferaft immediately after entering.

entries.en: Do not forget personal documents, your spectacles and medicine if necessary.
entries.zh: 不要忘记个人证件、眼镜，以及必要的药品。
entries.sourceEnglish: Do not forget personal documents, your spectacles and medicine if necessary.

entries.en: Search all WCs for missing persons.
entries.zh: 搜索所有卫生间，寻找失踪人员。
entries.sourceEnglish: Search all WCs for missing persons.

entries.en: From your assembly stations you will be escorted to your lifeboats.
entries.zh: 工作人员将从集合站引导各位前往救生艇。
entries.sourceEnglish: From your assembly stations you will be escorted to your lifeboats.

entries.en: Strictly obey all instructions given by the officer.
entries.zh: 严格服从驾驶员的所有指令。
entries.sourceEnglish: Strictly obey all instructions given by the officer.

entries.en: Never smoke on deck except in areas labelled as smoking areas.
entries.zh: 严禁在甲板吸烟，标明吸烟区的地方除外。
entries.sourceEnglish: Never smoke on deck except in areas labelled as smoking areas.

entries.en: Help children, elderly, disabled, injured or sick persons with lifejackets.
entries.zh: 协助儿童、老年人、残障人士、受伤人员或病人穿好救生衣。
entries.sourceEnglish: Help children, elderly, disabled, injured or sick persons with lifejackets.
